# Into the Wild — art generation prompt sheet

*Generated by `tools/art-manifest/build_manifest.py`. Do not hand-edit — change the script or `game/data/` and re-run.*

406 jobs in 8 batches. The same list is `manifest.json` (one object per job) — feed that to the image-generation agent; this sheet is for reading.

## How to run it

1. Generate batch **0-anchors** first and approve the three images by eye. They set the brush, the light and the UI material.
2. For every later job, attach the anchors named in its `references` as reference images (in Google Flow: save each anchor as an *Ingredient* and reference it). Keep reference sets to 2–4 images.
3. Run one batch per session with one seed family. Use each job's `aspect_ratio` as given; request 2K for icons/chrome and 4K for tiles, cards and screens, then downscale to `target_px`.
4. Save to the job's `output` path (repo-relative, under `art/`). Nothing under `art/` ships.
5. Cards: every job in **E-cards** except `card_back` is an *art panel* for the 468×240 window of the 512×768 card (`render_cards.py`), generated at 16:9 and center-cropped to 1872×960. Pasting panels into that window is the pending integration step in `render_cards.py`; `card_back` is delivered whole.
6. Non-card assets have a proposed `engine_target`; no code loads them yet (all UI is drawn in code today).
7. Paste each prompt verbatim, then the batch's negative prompt. Regenerate with a neighbour's seed before rewording.

## Style contract

**Painterly storybook — soft watercolor/gouache, warm natural light, wonder over grit** — docs/art-direction.md (designer-approved 2026-08-28).

| Use | Suffix appended to every prompt |
|---|---|
| Scenes, tiles, cards, screens | painterly storybook illustration, soft watercolor and gouache, warm diffused natural light, visible brush texture, gentle rounded shapes, wondrous and serene, no text, no letters, no watermark |
| Icons | flat game-UI icon, one centered symbol, bold clean silhouette that stays readable at 32 pixels, warm gold #f2d06b with bronze #8a6d3b inner shading on a flat deep-forest-ink #0b1712 background, faint parchment grain, storybook-ornament feel, no text |
| UI chrome, sigils | flat front-facing game-UI element, perfectly symmetrical and centered, no perspective, hand-painted storybook ornament, bronze #8a6d3b and gold #f2d06b filigree on deep-forest-ink #0b1712, faint parchment grain, crisp edges, no text |

**Negative prompt (all jobs):** text, letters, words, captions, logo, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, plastic, glossy, neon, lens flare, harsh black shadows, gore, blood, horror, grimdark, oversaturated, cluttered background, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate subject, cropped subject

**Negative prompt (icons, chrome):** text, letters, words, captions, logo, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, plastic, glossy, neon, lens flare, harsh black shadows, gore, blood, horror, grimdark, oversaturated, cluttered background, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate subject, cropped subject, perspective, scenery, landscape background, drop shadow

- Darkness reads as cold absence of warmth — never gore, never horror.
- The island is benevolent by default: creatures look gentle and curious unless the prompt says otherwise.
- One shared light: warm, diffused, golden-hour. No neon, no lens flare, no hard black shadows.
- No text inside any image. Titles, stats and card text are rendered by the engine / render_cards.py.
- Color is never the only carrier of information (asset-pipeline.md): every element also has its own icon and shape.
- Proposed art rule (not in data): creature scale reads tier — common small, uncommon mid-sized, rare large.

### Engine geometry

- Card 512×768; art window 468×240 at (22, 98); panels delivered at 1872×960.
- Hex tiles: **pointy-top** (`hex.gd`). Viewport 1920×1080, landscape.
- Card lookup: `res://assets/cards/<category>/<id>.png; action cards <id>_lvl<n>.png (card_view.gd get_card_texture_path)`.

### Generator notes (Nano Banana Pro)

- Model: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) — in Google Flow or through the Gemini API.
- Aspect ratios: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9.
- References: Attach the batch's style anchor (and the category anchor named in each job's `references`) as reference images on every job. Keep reference sets small — 2 to 4 clean, consistent images; large mismatched sets drift.
- Resolution: Request 2K for icons and chrome, 4K (API: image_size "4K") for tiles, cards and screens; downscale to each job's target_px on import.
- Flow: In Google Flow, save each anchor as an Ingredient and reference it from every job in the batch.
- Seeds: Generate each batch in one session with one seed family; regenerate a job with its neighbours' seed before changing the prompt.

## Batches

| Batch | Title | Jobs | Purpose |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 0-anchors | Style anchors | 3 | Generate first and approve by eye. Every later job references one of these. |
| A-chrome | UI chrome | 19 | 9-slice frames, buttons and HUD widgets. All UI is currently drawn in code (StyleBoxFlat) — these replace it visually without layout changes. |
| B-icons | Icon vocabulary | 51 | One icon per glyph the code currently draws as an emoji or Unicode symbol (dock buttons, HUD stats, tile markers, runes). |
| C-board | Board | 18 | Hex terrain tiles (pointy-top), face-down tiles, the Sanctum glow, the Guardian-site overlay and the pawn token. |
| D-sigils | Guardian sigils and gates | 8 | One sigil per element plus the Corrupt Gate (max-dark band) and the Guardian Gate (max-light band). |
| E-cards | Card illustrations | 297 | One art panel per existing card PNG (composited into the card frame by render_cards.py) plus the full-bleed card back. |
| F-screens | Screen backgrounds | 5 | Menu, character select, board backdrop, winner chronicle, modal texture. |
| G-store | Store and ship assets | 5 | App icon, adaptive icon layers, Play Store feature graphic, splash. |
